episodes.title: Offervilje
episodes.summary: City dweller Molly has difficulty adjusting to a new, downsized life in the country — until she learns why her neighbors are so attached to their pets.

episodes.title: Tre syke brødre
episodes.summary: After three years in a psychiatric hospital, Erik drives to his family's cabin with his brothers but trouble starts when they pick up a hitchhiker.

episodes.title: Karakterdrap
episodes.summary: The privileged Olivia eagerly embraces her new writing class but her instructor and an awkward fellow student soon have her questioning reality.

episodes.title: Rottefelle
episodes.summary: A pharmaceutical industry titan humiliates dinner guests — including his wife — when he discovers that one of them has stolen a valuable prototype.

episodes.title: Gammelskolen
episodes.summary: Idealistic teacher Sanna moves to a country school reopening after 40 years, where a mysterious tragedy reaches out to her from beyond the grave.

episodes.title: Elefanten i rommet
episodes.summary: At their wild holiday office party, two new employees hear strange rumors and try to solve the mystery of a coworker's grisly plunge from the roof.
